1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la persona de mucha palabra y poca acción.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This is said of a person who speaks much and does little.

Alternatively:

One described as speaking at length but taking little action.

Or more formally:

Characterized by verbosity and inaction.
